summary: Banco Santander (Brasil) filed a Form 6-K with the SEC reporting minutes of a Board of Directors meeting held on May 20, 2026. The Board acknowledged the resignation of Christian George Egan from his position as Vice-President Executive Officer. No price, stake, or other financial terms are present. This is a forced/abrupt departure filing without any special-situation transaction. The filing serves as a routine foreign private issuer report of management change.
